validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done"
                event:schema='{"type": "object", "properties": {"item": {"$ref": "item.json"}}}'/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the inline schema of `<transition>` has a reference the compiler cannot keep: `item.json` at `/properties/item/$ref` names another resource
notes: no schema is fetched: a `$ref` may only name a fragment of the same file (`#/$defs/Item`); when `event:schema` selects part of a file with a pointer, the references it uses are bundled into the result, which is impossible for schemas that rely on `$id`, `$anchor`, plain-name fragments, or dynamic references
diagnostics.help: copy the referenced schema into the same file and reference it by JSON Pointer, or reference the whole file without a fragment
